_README: Adjudicated verdicts applied by assemble.py at build time.
'quarantine' removes an item from the shipped bank. Use when the item is
ambiguous, has two defensible answers, or its explanation argues for a
different option than the key (re-keying alone would leave a wrong rationale).
'rekey' changes the recorded answer. Only safe when the explanation still
reads correctly for the new key — otherwise quarantine instead.
ALWAYS set stem_sha. Authoring agents sometimes rewrite an entire batch file,
so an id can come to hold a completely different question. The hash binds the
verdict to the content it was actually made about; if the stem changes, the
build refuses to apply the verdict and prints the new hash for re-review.
This is not theoretical — CKM-A-017 and CKM-A-022 were quarantined for real

Get an item's current hash with:  python build/audit.py  (or stem_fp in assemble.py)
